purpose: Resolve the frozen S4/S5 evidence-order cycle without changing any product requirement, Oracle, threshold, visual truth, architecture, or public-release gate.

owner_authorization.source: Direct owner instruction in this Codex task: 全部授权 不允许任何block
owner_authorization.scope: Authorize this explicit execution-order reconciliation only.
does_not_authorize: Waiving any frozen requirement, Oracle, threshold, or evidence item
Treating local checks, UNKNOWN, NOT_RUN, or WAIVED as product acceptance
Changing the frozen taskpack source files
Changing Sites audience, deploying publicly, configuring secrets, or using unlicensed assets

nonnegotiable_invariants: 07_acceptance/ACCEPTANCE_CONTRACT.json remains the only source of requirement text, threshold, Oracle, and evidence path.
07_acceptance/ORACLES.json remains the only source of Oracle definitions.
All fifteen frozen requirements must have real evidence bound to the exact source commit, tree, build artifact or Saved Version, and candidate configuration identity before final acceptance.
P0 and P1 must both be zero; UNKNOWN, NOT_RUN, and WAIVED never count as PASS.
Builder checks are observations only and never substitute for an independent final verifier.
The frozen five-page visual truth and all existing architecture boundaries remain unchanged.
No public audience change occurs before S6-T1 final independent acceptance and the pre-existing asset, privacy, and provider gates all pass.
No secret, user data, provider credential, or asset-rights record is added to this repository.

observed_cycle.source_s4_t3: S4-T3 requires a Saved Candidate and 15/15 real Acceptance evidence.
observed_cycle.source_s5_t1: S5-T1 depends on S4-T3 before it can save a private Version.
downstream_evidence: R-003 requires real Saved Candidate provider callbacks through S5-T3.
R-009 requires a Saved Version and rollback evidence through S5-T1 and S5-T3.
R-012 requires the sanitized operational projection through S5-T4.
R-014 requires production recovery evidence through S5-T3.
R-015 requires configured privacy and operational evidence through S5-T2 and S5-T4.
observed_cycle.resolution: Split the original S4-T3 into a non-final independent readiness gate and a post-evidence final independent acceptance; preserve all original requirements for the latter.

sequence.name: Independent candidate-readiness gate
must_not_claim: Authority to change public audience or deploy publicly

sequence.name: Save private evidence candidate
must_not_claim: R-009 final PASS before rollback evidence

sequence.name: Owner configuration on the private candidate
must_not_claim: public launch readiness without all existing gates

sequence.name: Controlled deployed candidate and recovery evidence
Final independent acceptance
must_not_claim: PASS if any exact-subject or evidence-integrity binding is absent

sequence.name: Public audience confirmation
must_require: all pre-existing asset-rights, privacy, provider, rollback, and audience gates pass
no uncommitted source or evidence drift
must_not_claim: GitHub upload before the overall taskpack is complete

final_independent_acceptance.evidence_integrity: Every evidence record must bind the exact source commit, tree, candidate identity, build or Saved Version identity, test identifier, raw-evidence digest or governed reference, and verifier result.
final_independent_acceptance.failure_rule: Any missing, mismatched, UNKNOWN, NOT_RUN, WAIVED, P0, or P1 result is FAIL, not a conditional PASS.

rollback.before_s6_t2: Keep the candidate private; on any failure restrict access and revert to the previous Saved Version without asserting public release.
rollback.after_s6_t2: Use the frozen rollback procedure: restrict audience, deploy the previous Saved Version, preserve evidence, and stop the release sequence.
